    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, extractOldExprVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at * <;>
    try simp_all

        apply fn_ih
        exact H1
        intros x Hin
        simp_all

        apply e_ih
        exact H2
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
  all_goals cases Hnorm <;> simp_all [List.Subset]
